consumer_contract.derivation: Two WORD A reads per row; A modulo = 2*row_stride_words-4. Each final column starts at the last mask WORD. Final-row read therefore includes the following WORD even with BLTALWM=0. Owned read footprint includes that WORD, not an invented initialized mask field.
consumer_contract.high_last_consumer: hooligan_frames_4A07C_3: mask bank08, stride4 WORDs, height32, width64; constructor produces128 WORDs.
consumer_contract.limits: Original valid geometry/clipping contract only, not arbitrary modified descriptors or a complete DMA/lifetime proof. Guard values are not inferred zero. All leases remain through final blitter completion.

initialization: Constructor writes the listed mask extents. Read guards retain prior contents; no zero/file seed or whole-allocation initialization claim.
other_policy: Middle generated masks remain inside retained input; no font/bank45 layout changes.
